profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software engineer working on distributed systems, databases, and other infrastructure areas. I enjoy working with people as much as I do writing code. Interested in learning more about innovation and what it actually takes to build new technology.

Primary language is golang, primary focus area is data infrastructure. Very experienced with the kubernetes ecosystem.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Data Platforms team. We love kubernetes, golang, and data!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on real-time storage and retrieval of time-series data for financial markets, using a mixture of open source and in-house solutions.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Argo · Amazon S3 · gRPC · Cassandra · Docker Products · Helm Charts · Kubernetes · Redis · Bash · MongoDB · Helm (Software)

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: OLAP/ClickHouse team. My last major project was to architect and implement a customer-facing Looker integration on our ClickHouse database. I worked with senior technical leaders to bridge Looker's gaps in ClickHouse support and make our integration hardened and production-ready, building custom solutions where needed for properties like high availability and shard-aware query routing. I continued owning our control plane service. I also was helping plan potential migrations from our on-prem data centers to public cloud providers like AWS and GCP.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: OLAP/ClickHouse team. I continued owning our control plane service and also contributed to projects like shard rebalancing and the design phase of our ClickHouse/Looker integration (discussed above). For shard rebalancing, I wrote a distributed go application to reconcile two different shard rings and move data between servers as needed, as part of a broader design to migrate data between shards with no customer downtime.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: OLAP/ClickHouse team. I was responsible for our control plane service (golang) and setting up ClickHouse in our dedicated FedRAMP clusters. I also helped one of our lead engineers write a kubernetes operator to set up ClickHouse in new data centers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer for the backend services (golang) supporting various in-app safety features.
• Led API migration for 911 button. Managed vendor relationship. Migration simplified codebase, improved location precision, and reduced latency slightly (700ms reduction). Go, Thrift, Kafka.
• Led integration between rider/driver training datastore and Uber's account deactivation broadcaster. Used tombstone records to overwrite stored PII. Go, Thrift, Schemaless (proprietary DB).

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
Data Scientist working on global platform safety for Uber, Uber Eats, and other product lines.
• Wrote ETL framework in python to route safety reports to our audit process. Saved 100s of hours of manual point-and-click tasks.
• Developed system to flag low-credibility safety-related feedback tags on trips and orders, protecting riders/drivers from negative account actions.
• Prepared audited statistics for Uber's published transparency report, first of its kind effort to disclose rate of serious issues on platform.
• Designed tool to bulk-update taxonomy mappings, eliminating more point-and-click labor.
• Led quarterly safety syncs for EMEA, sharing updates between product/safety leaders in HQ and local ops leaders in EMEA

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description: Built analytics (R/Shiny dashboard) for monitoring computer lab usage and health. Dashboard used in board meetings to identify struggling schools and high-performing schools for expansion. Data pipeline in R against MySQL.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: AP Calculus and Statistics tutor.

positions.title: Lifeguard
positions.description: Self-studying data science and programming.

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America, Troop 37 · Sep 2010

volunteerExperiences.description: Non-profit building school computer labs in Tanzania using recycled laptops and servers from the US.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Rancho San Antonio Open Space Preserve
volunteerExperiences.description: Reconstructed two Ohlone sleeping huts for model Native American village in Rancho San Antonio in Cupertino. Got terrible poison oak - yay!
